scope: The standing Kasbah of the Udayas in Rabat, including the Almohad walls and principal Grand Gate, coastal bastions, the palace and Andalusian garden enclosure, the mosque skyline and mapped white residential roof mass.

originalReview.notes: The east skyline seen across the Bou Regreg shows the white roof mass, narrow square minaret, river-facing terrace walls and stepped land profile.

references.filename: Soccer match by the gate of the Kasbah (Kasbah of the Udayas, Rabat, Morocco) (15748035002).jpg

originalReview.notes: The exterior from the square shows the principal carved horseshoe arch, its broad stair, the rounded tower, pointed merlons, tall square buttress towers, and the secondary door.
